_comment: Scheduled live course groups. The course page renders `sessions` as fixed dates with a per-date payment link; when the list is empty it falls back to the application form, so the page is always valid. Policy: a group runs from `minSeats` paid participants; below that the participant moves to the next month, takes a refund, or converts the payment into a consultation. Add a session: { date (ISO), label (Latvian, as shown), time, format, seats, url (payment link) }.
